answer.rationale: With the line at 94% committed volume and no buffer, even a brief migration or delivery failure could outweigh the quoted savings. The incumbent has demonstrated stable integration and uninterrupted scheduled deliveries. Verify memory_c2 because switching is the only stated option that independently meets the spend mandate, but the consolidated memory confirms onboarding and invoicing—not delivery performance at this utilization level. Unless the source record resolves that gap, renewal best protects total cost of ownership, while accepting that the 18% target will require action next cycle.
